name: Band Push-Up
steps: Wrap a resistance band across your upper back, loop each end around your palms, and set up in a high plank.
Brace your abs and glutes firmly so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows at roughly 45 degrees from your torso to lower your chest smoothly toward the floor.
Drive powerfully through your hands against the increasing band tension until your arms extend fully at the top.
tips: Keep the band positioned cleanly across your shoulder blades rather than sliding up toward your neck.
Press smoothly through the harder top half without letting your hips sag downward.
